invariants.name: Tenant isolation
tests: only returns rows for the bound university
cannot read another university's user even with the exact id
refuses a write that names another university

invariants.name: Hidden and nonexistent are indistinguishable
tests: level and public posts reach exactly the right students

invariants.name: Blocks are symmetric and mutes are private
tests: hides content in both directions when either side blocked
mutes only the muter's view and never hides the author from themselves

invariants.name: Reposts inherit the original audience
tests: inherits the original audience on every repost

invariants.name: Role boundaries
tests: reviewer cannot reach students or team management
student cannot reach either console
platform admin creates a space and sees the audit trail

invariants.name: Private ID images require reviewer access
tests: admin sees the queue and a private ID image

invariants.name: Public preview privacy
tests: public share preview reveals no author, counts or metadata

invariants.name: Service worker never caches private data
tests: forces API responses to the network and every navigation is network-only

invariants.name: Logout clears caches, IndexedDB and account storage
tests: logout clears the cached feed, cookies and IndexedDB

invariants.name: Offline outbox is idempotent
tests: offline outbox publishes once after reconnect

invariants.name: Community names normalize and reserved names stay blocked
tests: normalizes lookalike names before uniqueness checks
reserves official, university and academic names

invariants.name: Community visibility follows privacy, archived and suspended rules
tests: keeps REQUEST metadata visible while its content stays member-only
makes INVITE_ONLY indistinguishable from a missing community to outsiders
keeps archived communities readable by members only

invariants.name: Community permissions and ownership are table-driven
tests: enforces owner, moderator and member actions with mute and upload rules
chooses a moderator first and never transfers to an inactive owner

invariants.name: Community posts never widen into academic feeds
tests: keeps community posts out of academic feeds and honours access

invariants.name: Community invites are hashed and single-purpose
tests: stores only a hash of a high-entropy invite token

invariants.name: Community discovery and request joins are server-authorized
tests: keeps invite-only communities out of discovery for outsiders
keeps request joins pending until a moderator approves them
never exposes another university's communities through the tenant client

invariants.name: Communities always retain at least one owner
tests: transfers ownership and protects the last owner from leaving
the database refuses to remove the last owner even outside the service

invariants.name: Invite-only communities are indistinguishable from missing ones
tests: invite-only communities are indistinguishable from missing ones for outsiders
